sections.Results outcome 002:
Outcome: The Mean Change in Mini Rhinoconjunctivitis Quality of Life Questionnaire (MiniRQLQ) Overall Score
Type: SECONDARY
Time frame: 8 weeks (from Week 0 to Week 8)
Description: Mini Rhinoconjunctivitis Quality of Life Questionnaire (MiniRQLQ) consists of 14 questions to assess patient's overall quality of life related to allergic rhinitis on a scale of 0 (least impairment) to 6 (greatest impairment). The score is the mean of the 14 questions, ranging from 0 to 6. Change is computed as Week 8 score - Week 0 score
Population: Based on ITT population; there were 286 patients with available data regarding the mean change in MiniRQLQ at week 8.
Reporting status: POSTED
Group: Treatment Phase (All Patients) Week 8 | id=OG000
Units: Units on a Scale
Measure parameter type: MEAN
Measure dispersion type: Standard Deviation

Measurement (Units on a Scale): group=Treatment Phase (All Patients) Week 8 (id=OG000); value=-1.45; spread=1.35
sections.Results outcome 003:
Outcome: Effectiveness of Montelukast Therapy Used in Combination With Inhaled Corticosteroids or Inhaled Corticosteroids / Long-Acting Beta 2-Agonist in Improving the Symptoms of Asthma Using the Asthma Control Questionnaire (ACQ)
Type: SECONDARY
Time frame: 8 weeks (from Week 0 to Week 8)
Description: The Asthma Control Questionnaire consists of 7 specific questions that were used to assess patient asthma control at week 0 and week 8. The mean score per question is used to determine the level of control, with a final score ranging from 0 (well-controlled) to 6 (extremely poorly controlled) units on a scale.
Population: There were 313 patients who qualified for inclusion in the intent to treat (ITT) analysis and completed the first visit; of these, 300 patients completed the ACQ at week 8.
Reporting status: POSTED
Group: Treatment Phase (All Patients) Week 0 | id=OG000
Group: Treatment Phase (All Patients) Week 8 | id=OG001
Units: Units on a Scale
Measure parameter type: MEAN
Measure dispersion type: Standard Deviation
Denominator (Participants): group=Treatment Phase (All Patients) Week 0 (id=OG000); value=313
Denominator (Participants): group=Treatment Phase (All Patients) Week 8 (id=OG001); value=300
Measurement (Units on a Scale): group=Treatment Phase (All Patients) Week 0 (id=OG000); value=2.03; spread=0.80
Measurement (Units on a Scale): group=Treatment Phase (All Patients) Week 8 (id=OG001); value=0.92; spread=0.80
Analysis groups: Treatment Phase (All Patients) Week 0 (id=OG000), Treatment Phase (All Patients) Week 8 (id=OG001)
Analysis: statistical method=t-test, 2 sided; non-inferiority type=SUPERIORITY_OR_OTHER_LEGACY; p value=<0.001
